description: This file defines the 'Note' class representing a user note with properties such as id, title, content, category, and updatedAt timestamp. It includes methods for serialization to and from a Map/JSON format, as well as a copyWith method for creating modified copies of Note instances.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A model class representing a user note with title, content, category, and timestamp metadata.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Note instance into a Map<String, dynamic> for storage or serialization.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Creates a Note instance from a Map<String, dynamic> (usually from deserialization).

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Note instance with optional overridden fields.
